svg.title: Evidence-grounded evaluation across local units and the whole song
svg.desc: Editable protocol schematic. Q1-Q3 local text quality; M1-M3 local music compatibility; G1-G3 global composition. M3 is affective compatibility without an event gate. All waveforms, poses and quotation are illustrative, with no assigned candidate scores.

g.text: Check across units and musical sections.
Independent criteria, not a weighted total
Evidence first, then a justified rating
Vague text receives a content score.
Allow half-time, holds, grounded contrast and choreography reused across songs.
